verdict.rationale: Anrok documents feeding tax calculations into the billing system's invoices via its Transactions API and Stripe integration. It also tells sellers which customer tax IDs to collect in each jurisdiction, which covers part of the required VAT fields. Nothing shows seller registration numbers, mandatory VAT invoice wording, or locale-specific invoice formatting flowing onto invoices or being generated by Anrok. missing for 10: seller VAT registration numbers on invoices, locale-specific invoice compliance rules (e.g. reverse-charge notes, required fields per country), Anrok-generated compliant invoices, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, invoices come out compliant where I sell — required VAT fields, registration numbers, and locale rules flow through to my invoicing system or are generated by the product itself

citations.quote: Use Anrok's Transactions API to synchronize transactions between Anrok and your billing system, as well as calculate sales tax for new invoices.
Sellers utilizing Stripe Subscriptions or Checkout may also use this API to calculate and add tax on initial invoices
Anrok provides a list of valid tax IDs for each applicable jurisdiction.
